tasks.label: Prepare and build Viveiro app
args: Set-Location 'C:\Users\karol\OneDrive\Documentos\tand\sistema-controle-tand'; $cache = Join-Path $env:TEMP 'tand-laravel-cache'; New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force $cache | Out-Null; $env:APP_PACKAGES_CACHE = Join-Path $cache 'packages.php'; $env:APP_SERVICES_CACHE = Join-Path $cache 'services.php'; if (-not (Test-Path '.env')) { Copy-Item '.env.example' '.env' }; if (-not (Test-Path 'database\database.sqlite')) { New-Item -ItemType File 'database\database.sqlite' | Out-Null }; php artisan key:generate; if (-not $?) { exit 1 }; php artisan migrate --force; if (-not $?) { exit 1 }; npm ci; if (-not $?) { exit 1 }; npm run build; if (-not $?) { exit 1 }

tasks.label: Initialize Viveiro database
args: if not exist "%TEMP%\tand-laravel-cache" mkdir "%TEMP%\tand-laravel-cache" & set APP_PACKAGES_CACHE=%TEMP%\tand-laravel-cache\packages.php & set APP_SERVICES_CACHE=%TEMP%\tand-laravel-cache\services.php & cd /d C:\Users\karol\OneDrive\Documentos\tand\sistema-controle-tand & if not exist .env copy .env.example .env & if not exist database\database.sqlite type nul > database\database.sqlite & php artisan key:generate & php artisan migrate --force
